scientific_question: When arm/workload is block-randomized independently of global execution order and non-invasive state covariates are recorded before every cell, does the W-S non-material / W-C material total-transfer split replicate, and after nuisance-state balancing do B-A and C-B become stably identifiable?

arms.A_CANONICAL: current canonical runtime; no ANL64 plan
arms.B_PLAN_PREBOUND: exact ANL64 immutable plan prebound before timing; canonical executor choices preserved
arms.C_PLAN_PREBOUND_RESIDUAL: same prebound plan plus only residual 84 Q/K/O Q4_FAST substitutions

state_surface.role: environment validity plus secondary nuisance description only

replication_rules.stability: pooled classification stable only if at least 5/6 block classifications agree
replication_rules.W_S_total_split_replication: pooled C/A non-material AND >=5/6 blocks non-material
replication_rules.W_C_total_split_replication: pooled C/A material AND >=5/6 blocks material
replication_rules.total_TTFT_guard: for each workload pooled C/A TTFT<=1.1 AND >=5/6 blocks TTFT-safe
replication_rules.plan_identifiable: for each workload pooled B/A no-harm classification has >=5/6 block agreement
replication_rules.residual_identifiable: for each workload pooled C/B material/non-material classification has >=5/6 block agreement

cross_block_boundary_rule.decision_role: secondary nuisance description only; cannot change primary block estimands or outcome class

nuisance_analysis.unstable_decomposition_interpretation: underidentified/unstable after balancing; do not assign cause

blocking_guards: exact token equality across matched A/B/C within workload
all 36 scheduled cells present for performance adjudication

stop_rules.before_cell_environment: collector failure, missing required field, non-Balanced power scheme, or AC_line_status!=1 => do not launch cell; stop entire collection as ENVIRONMENT_OR_INFRASTRUCTURE_STOP
stop_rules.completed_cell_semantic_or_structural_fa: stop immediately; no performance interpretation; no further cells
stop_rules.infrastructure_interruption_before_valid: stop entire collection; no automatic retry/resume; only a newly authorized full replay from zero may proceed
stop_rules.adaptive_behavior: no performance/covariate-triggered cooldown, delay, cleanup, power change, threshold change, deletion, substitution or reorder

mutually_exclusive_outcome_classes.PASS_TOTAL_SPLIT_AND_DECOMPOSITION_IDENT: G3 PASS, G4 PASS, G5 PASS, G6 PASS
mutually_exclusive_outcome_classes.PASS_TOTAL_SPLIT_DECOMPOSITION_REMAINS_U: G3 PASS, G4 PASS, and either G5 or G6 FAIL
mutually_exclusive_outcome_classes.ENVIRONMENT_OR_INFRASTRUCTURE_STOP_NO_SC: pre-cell environment/collector failure or infrastructure interruption before complete admissible collection
